turns.question: It's the end of 7 October 2026. How many customers who signed up in 2026 have never placed an order?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for customers who never ordered, so I can't give that count; the closest are Signups, 20 customers who signed up between 1 January and 7 October 2026 (counted on their signup day), and Active customers, 4 of those 2026 signups who have a non-cancelled order placed 1 January to 7 October 2026, so customers whose only orders were cancelled are counted as neither. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
